TASK: Complete the source-backed treatment specification and reference/error-budget prerequisites. This is a scoped use of the existing motor, not a newly invented motor or scientific Q.

EXACT QUESTION: Kan den oprindelige Q041 downstream-portabilitetstest udføres med en ny præregistreret, konvergensrobust inference-strategi, der nøjagtigt bevarer den oprindelige scientific contract — begge native Planck-arme, ΛCDM og n=3 EDE, ACT DR6 primary, ACT DR6 lensing, DESI DR2, én identisk frozen supernova-likelihood, FULL + fire leave-one-out-tests og de oprindelige materialitets-/modelpræferenceregler — uden at genbruge Q040's invaliderede science-endpoints, uden cross-arm absolute objective arithmetic og uden retroaktivt at ændre kriterier efter resultaterne?

Read q042_execution_handoff_treatment_readiness.md in full, including the verbatim inherited journal appendix. Read q042_treatment_readiness.json and q042_treatment_source_evidence.json. The readiness handoff contains the actual source register and claim map, control results, frozen settings and previous failures. Do not replace it with this task prompt alone.

Recommended current setup: GPT-6.1 Sol / High, bounded reasoning and source retrieval. Reassess actual capabilities if the mathematics becomes materially difficult; do not claim a model switch. Use read-only GitHub and primary technical sources only when they add missing reference evidence. Do not assume examples in a motor list prove an engine is established.

PURPOSE
Resolve the narrowly missing treatment definition, valid reference products and numerical error budget before a candidate run. Expected output is an immutable executable-ready preregistration or a finite documented BLOCKED result with the exact unsupported condition. No arbitrary numerical tolerance may be guessed.

PRESERVED STATE
V25 control run 37288546095 and binary df1e81831dae7e88b651342a3d72de7597cf2b1145586035c6226715dbca04cf remain the failing control; do not repeat them unchanged. V22–V25 technical tasks are complete. Keep all 80 optimizer records and earlier failures; no Q040 endpoints or cross-arm absolute objective arithmetic. Exact science specification SHA256 41e4d8f026933f64dbe41048f894002f479ba2b504432b33dc155f4dfe71378c remains authoritative, including both Planck arms, LCDM and n=3 EDE, all datasets/likelihoods/priors, FULL plus four LOO comparisons and original materiality/model-preference criteria.

DOCUMENTED CAUSE AND REFERENCES
The archived scalar source replay reproduces an overflow just above xHeII=1e-6 at radiation temperature 49.524694827192945 K; the preceding state lies below the cutoff and returns zero. NDF15 finite-difference involvement is consistent with the observed increment, not established by call-stack telemetry. The frozen HyRec standalone history stops simultaneous H/He evolution after the cutoff; this suggests studying phase management rather than clipping derivatives or raising the cutoff. It is not proof that a stateful RHS latch is correct. Current official CLASS has the missing lower reio_camb break, but its wrapper still has the same strict helium cutoff. Do not replace the frozen core wholesale with current CLASS. The retrieved V22 synthetic checkpoint reference and Q041/V19 unconverged-chain means are explicitly unsuitable as CLASS prediction benchmarks.

FINITE TASK
1. Recover a minimal complete matched known-valid reference set from existing source-locked project artifacts. Identify its full cosmological/nuisance inputs, model, binary/source/config identities and actual prediction/likelihood products. Check validity and Q relevance. If none exists, define a separate independent reference-generation requirement before evaluating a treatment; do not label an arbitrary point known-valid.
2. Specify one source-backed accepted-state helium phase treatment, including what triggers transition, whether residual helium is retained, and how accepted/rejected timesteps and Jacobian perturbations behave. Show its relationship to the frozen approximation. A mutable flag set by a trial RHS evaluation is not automatically an accepted-state event. Keep the 1e-6 cutoff, physical inputs and current precision unchanged unless a separately justified numerical change is explicitly preregistered.
3. Include the minimal lower reio_camb branch correction and explicit nonfinite tau/bracket rejection in that same candidate. Preserve half_tanh semantics and raw failures. These guards diagnose failure; they do not prove a repaired physical history.
4. Derive and document numerical error criteria for independent realized tau, thermodynamic history/interpolation, prediction vectors and relevant within-arm likelihood evaluations. The observed 1e-4 bracket-width setting is a solver stopping rule; PolyChord precision_criterion=0.001 is a sampler setting; scientific model-preference thresholds are decision criteria. None silently provides a CLASS treatment accuracy budget. Justify reference accuracy and budget against the unchanged scientific decisions. If not defensible, return BLOCKED.
5. Freeze the exact minimal patch/content hash, source tree/build recipe/config, future resulting binary identity, reference products, metrics and acceptance numbers before candidate outputs are inspected. A build identity can be recorded after compilation, but patch/reference/criteria must precede treatment evaluation. Preserve original cache and binary. New numerical lineage forbids resuming old likelihood-bearing sampler states by default; do not authorize production.
6. Only after all preregistration gates pass, return to the existing execution motor for one bounded candidate evaluation at the failing point and minimum necessary reference(s), using TREATMENT-T001–T006 from the readiness JSON. Search/reuse/patch before new code. If actual software is then needed, provide individual files and a unique registered PROGRAM_ID through the permanent launcher. Include a measured runtime budget and split only where necessary. No automatic retries or new optimizer starts.

JOURNAL AND SOURCE HANDLING
Update only the affected claims. Carry every existing source ID; record additions with stable new IDs and exact claim mappings. Separate proposed mathematics, externally retrieved code, internal controls and actually computed new values. All absent fields stay NOT DOCUMENTED. Preserve rejected/superseded material and unexplained discrepancies.

SUCCESS
A complete source-backed preregistration with valid reference products, justified frozen numerical metrics/tolerances, exact candidate/config/build identities and new-lineage policy, ready for one finite evaluation. This is a preparation success, not Q closure, a repaired-run result or production authorization.

FAILURE / STOP
If the treatment equivalence, reference validity or accuracy budget cannot be defended in this finite task, return BLOCKED with the specific evidence gap. Do not run a candidate, generate a misleading launcher entry, adjust thresholds after outcomes, swap recombination models or repeat V25 unchanged. If one later preregistered candidate fails, retain its raw result and stop that candidate; do not enter a rescue loop.

RETURN ROUTE
Exactly one: BUBBLEVERSE — RESULT INGESTION & ROUTING ENGINE. Carry the complete handoff/journal, readiness delta, source register, claim map, reference/criteria/lineage decisions and uncertainty. Ingestion evaluates Q completion; completed Q goes directly to MOTOR 14. Report Writer is excluded.
